bio_html: Oluwaseun is a Chemistry PhD candidate at the University of Georgia specializing in bioanalytical chemistry, omics research, enzymology, structural biology, and computational modeling. Doctoral research focuses on AprL, a PLP-dependent aminotransferase in apramycin biosynthesis relevant to antimicrobial resistance, combining enzyme kinetics, X-ray crystallography, and computational workflows. Alongside the PhD, Oluwaseun just completed a Co-Op role with the API Cell Engineering Analytical Sciences' Automation team at Johnson & Johnson's Spring House site, in Pennsylvania, developing robotic workcell control logic and autonomous transport systems for biotherapeutic manufacturing.
